name: claude-os
description: Build your own Claude OS: guided builders that stand up a workspace for your business. No AI Slop writing rules and a Session Audit run automatically; the main builder creates your folder, Front Desk router, memory, and brand one-pager and hands you savable copies of those two skills to own; follow-up builders create your voice, ICP, design guidelines, and brand story, one per session; and a Migrator brings your old folder, workspace, or Claude Project into the OS.
